{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of rows with customer_age == -1: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0]}")

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1
filtered_df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = filtered_df['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age}")

# Also check the total count for context
print(f"Total customers in filtered data: {filtered_df.shape[0]}")"}
